Similarly, total assigned to block B = from S_A assigned to B (a_{BC}) + from S_C assigned to B (c_{CB}) where c_{CB} = number from S_C assigned to B = (size of S_C) - c_{AB} = 3 - c_{AB} = must be 3.

Total assigned to block C = from S_A assigned to C (3 - a_{BC}) + from S_B assigned to C (3 - b_{AC}) = must be 3.

Thus we have three equations:

1) b_{AC} + c_{AB} = 3
2) a_{BC} + (3 - c_{AB}) = 3 => a_{BC} - c_{AB} = 0 => a_{BC} = c_{AB}
3) (3 - a_{BC}) + (3 - b_{AC}) = 3 => 6 - (a_{BC} + b_{AC}) = 3 => a_{BC} + b_{AC} = 3

(1) b + c = 3
(2) a = c
